notes.title: Forest Fox Hunting!
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements[/b]

- Improved the translation of menu items and added the ability to change language within the game.

- Droidmals encountered around the city will now display health points in real time.

[b]Gameplay[/b]

- Added a side quest that will allow you to face a new boss.

- Added the ability to re-challenge some Droidmals after capturing them.

- Added a new evolutionary line of Droidmals.

[b]Bugfix[/b]

- Fixed a bug that didn't always make it possible to interact with objects if you played using only the mouse.
